# Ayala Malls Manila Bay

Ayala Malls Manila Bay is a large shopping mall located in Parañaque City, Metro Manila, Philippines. Here's what I know about it:

## Location & Access
- Situated along Diosdado Macapagal Boulevard, corner Aseana Avenue, in the Aseana City development in Parañaque
- Part of the Bay Area/Entertainment City district
- Near the Mall of Asia complex and close to Ninoy Aquino International Airport (NAIA)
- Accessible via the NAIA Expressway

## Background
- Developed and operated by Ayala Land, through its subsidiary Ayala Malls
- Opened in November 2018
- One of the larger Ayala-branded malls in Metro Manila

## Features & Size
- Has a gross floor area of approximately 250,000+ square meters
- Four levels of retail and dining space
- Designed with a coastal/bayside theme reflecting its proximity to Manila Bay

## Tenants & Attractions
- Houses a wide variety of retail brands, both local and international
- Features Ayala Cinemas with multiple screens, including IMAX and Director's Club options
- Several anchor tenants including The Landmark department store
- Various dining options ranging from fast food to fine dining
- Family entertainment areas

## Notable Aspects
- Built in an area that was developed as part of the broader Entertainment City/Bay Area redevelopment
- Close to integrated resorts like Solaire, City of Dreams Manila, and Okada Manila
- Serves residents of nearby condominium developments and travelers from the airport

If you're looking for very specific or up-to-date information (current store directory, operating hours, ongoing promotions), I'd recommend checking Ayala Malls' official website or social media channels, as those details can change.
